verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents defining models via SQL, dbt, or a visual builder on existing warehouse tables and views, and building audiences on top of them. It then syncs that data to 300+ destinations with CDC, and the docs say it runs on the warehouse without copying data into a separate system. A cofounder's community account corroborates that data stays in the customer's warehouse and that syncs are declarative from SQL models. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the audience-building flow on existing warehouse tables (community evidence covers the architecture and syncs, not audiences).
